question: DEAP是否在固定人工问题和计算上限下比直接NumPy公式筛选增加可靠、可读的关系搜索能力
decision_use: 只决定是否保留可选研究搜索工具；不改变LEI规则或声称金融有效/整套自主研究有效

external.license: LGPL-3.0 as wheel license; do not vendor third-party source

data.generation: numpy default_rng for each split; same x for all tasks; task-specific independent noise seed split_seed+991+task_index*10000

grammar.invalid_predictions: nonfinite or abs>1e6 => score 1e30; record count; do not silently drop rows

search.selection: best training score; validation used only to select among direct baseline model variants, never test/ood

arms.external: DEAP tree generator, tournament selection, subtree crossover/uniform mutation, elitism 1; evaluate full population every generation even clones, exactly128*(1+24)=3200 counted candidates; all overlimit/rejected proposals counted
arms.random_control: same DEAP initial tree generator/grammar/depths used as shared representation, independent random trees, no evolution;3200 candidates; controls added value of selection/mutation, not a wholly DEAP-free baseline
arms.direct_baseline: NumPy only: training mean, degree<=1 linear least squares, degree<=3 polynomial least squares, and greedy orthogonal matching pursuit up to4 terms from all degree1..3 monomials plus xi/(1+xj^2) for all i,j. intercept always present. train chooses OMP terms, validation chooses 0/1/2/3/4 terms versus other baselines. train/validation only; test/ood evaluated after choices fixed. No oracle coefficients/target name branching.

success.accuracy: external test AND outside-range MSE <=0.9*best-direct-validation-selected MSE in at least2/3 seeds on >=1 signal task; additive external not >1.1*direct in >=2/3 seeds; no noise promotion
success.noise_policy: noise can never be promoted to valid relationship; report its error against training mean and no known population relationship; favorable accidental test error is not reliable evidence
success.independent_checks: data hashes, formula evaluation by separate restricted AST interpreter for exported formula predictions, accurate candidate counts, test/ood excluded from training/selection; re-evaluate archived outputs without search
success.efficiency: record measured wall time per arm; user interventions after frozen contract; model calls/fees unknown if unmetered; no human labor savings claim without measured baseline
success.decision: adopt only if accuracy criteria hold plus reliable evidence/maintainable bounded interface; otherwise reject for default integration; narrower engineering facts may be retained

stopping: question answered or genuine missing input/permission; no tuning after results; failure/retry preserved, followups only for core correctness/restore not hunting positive
prior_evidence: Existing RD-Agent,QuantaAlpha,tsfresh,arch,catch22 sealed; no corresponding new symbolic-search report found by scoped repo search.
